issues.description: ExcellenceLand's boolean attribute is named "excellentEnough" in the UML/problem statement, but the solution names the field "isExcellent" and provides getter "isExcellent()". This breaks the expected 1:1 mapping from UML attribute names to constructor parameters/getters required by the task, potentially causing students to implement different names than the reference/tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the name consistent between UML/problem statement and solution. Preferred: rename the solution field to "excellentEnough" and adjust the constructor parameter name and getter accordingly (e.g., "isExcellentEnough()" or "getExcellentEnough()", matching the course/test convention).
